faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: A quick overview of how the platform and trip booking work.

items.q: How do I book a seat?
items.a: Enter your route, date, and number of passengers in the search, pick a trip, review the driver's profile and vehicle, then click 'Book'. The request goes to the driver — once confirmed, you'll receive pickup details.

items.q: Do I pay at the time of booking?
items.a: The trip cost is calculated automatically: the price per seat multiplied by the number of seats. Cash payment to the driver and online payment via Kyrgyzstan's payment systems are both supported.

items.q: Can I be both a driver and a passenger?
items.a: Yes. One account lets you switch between driver and passenger modes. To publish trips you need to complete identity verification and add a vehicle.
Drivers go through verification: phone confirmation, identity and driving document checks, and vehicle inspection. The verification status is shown on the profile and trip card.

items.q: What happens if a trip is cancelled?
items.a: When a driver cancels, all confirmed passengers receive a notification. Cancellation and refund rules are set within the platform — terms are always visible before you book.
GETTIK.KG works as a Progressive Web App: add the site to your phone's home screen, receive push notifications, and use the offline page — no app store download required.
